'''Siege Skytroopers''' were a [[skytrooper]] variant used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Several times larger than a regular [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized version skytrooper, the Siege Skytroopers was powerful enough to go face-to-face with a [[Walker/Legends|walker]]. During the [[Assault on Odessen]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> in [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|5.0}}</ref> a Siege Skytrooper was encountered by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Siege Skytroopers appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' '''"Chapter VIII: End Times".'''
